title: Memory Allocate
text: Allocate memory for new variable, {Variable name} sets Name for variable; {Specify variable alignment} sets the variable alignment flag, {Memory alignment boundary} sets the memory alignment for variable, {Data type}, {Specify data type qualifier} sets the data type qualifier flag, {Data type qualifier}, {Data dimension} sets the number of elements of variable data type, {Initialize memory} sets the memory initialization flag, {Initial value}, {Specify memory section} sets the memory section flag, {Memory section}, {Bind memory section} and {Section start address} sets the start address of memory section for variable. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Name for variable myVariable (default) | string | character vector

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type for variable uint32 (default) | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean

params.name: Specify data type qualifier
params.values: Data type qualifier flag off (default) | on

params.name: Data type qualifier
params.values: Data type qualifier for variable volatile (default) | sting | character vectory

params.name: Data dimension
params.values: Number of elements of variable data type 64 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Initial value
params.values: Initial value for variable 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Memory section
params.values: Memory section for variable mySEC1 (default) | string | character vector

params.name: Bind memory section
params.values: Bind memory section to start address flag off (default) | on

params.name: Section start address
params.values: Start address of memory section for variable hex2dec(’8000’) (default) | memory address in decimal or hexadecimal form
